description:
Caves have witnessed humanity's darkest moments. From cavers trapped in impossible passages in England's Peak Cavern and Mossdale, to Nazi executions in Italian quarries and Khmer Rouge atrocities in Cambodia, to fatal dives in Australia and the Maldives... these underground horrors reveal just how deadly the subterranean world can be.
